tone.title: Deluxe Reverb '65 Reissue Clean
tone.description:
Get the full capture pack for this amp here : 
https://gindabestari.com/

Fender Deluxe Reverb '65 Reissue. Clean Sound. Mic'd with Shure SM57 + Royer Ribbon R-121 + Universal Audio OX for Mono Room Sound (Neumann U67 Modeling in OX)

3 Models Available to Download. Closed Mics with Room, Closed Mics without Room and Room Sound only, so you can blend it in post.

Models :
- Fender DRRI | Clean | SM57 + Royer R-121 + Room | Full Rig
- Fender DRRI | Clean | SM57 + Royer R-121 (No Room) | Full Rig
- Fender DRRI | Clean | Room Only | Full Rig
- Fender DRRI | Clean | DI Capture No Cab

NEW VERSION Update :
- The Noise Floor is Lower Than The Previous Version
- Higher Epochs Than The Previous Version
- Better Transient Response
- I Turned Down the Room Level on Microphones Blend (57+121+Room)
- I Added DI Capture (No Cab)

Amp Setting :
- Vibrato Channel
- Volume 3, Bass 5, Treble 7

Speaker :
- 12" Jensen® C-12K Speaker

Microphones :
- Shure SM57
- Royer R-121
- Universal Audio OX (Neumann U67 Microphone Modeling for Mono Room Sound)

Audio Interface, Studio Outboard & Cables:
- Great River ME-1NV Mic Pre (for SM57)
- Cranborne Audio EC1 Mic Pre (for Royer R-121)
- Little Labs Redeye 3D Phantom Direct Box & Re-Amp Box
- Universal Audio Apollo Twin Audio Interface
- Evidence Audio Lyric HG Instrument Cables
- Mogami 2549 Microphone Cables

Enjoy :)
